# AgentBar

> AgentBar is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows 10/11 app that shows every running Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI chat as a small status square in the Windows taskbar, next to the system tray.

- Status is shown by each square's background: working (dull orange), done and waiting on you (green), needs an answer (blue), idle (collapses to a thin bar).
- Each square's border is the chat's own colour (Claude Code's /color), so chats are easy to tell apart.
- Clicking a square brings that chat's window (Zed, Windows Terminal, VS Code, Cursor, and others) to the front.
- It reads only local files the tools already keep (~/.claude/sessions, ~/.claude/projects, ~/.codex). No API keys, no network requests, never modifies those files.
- Install: clone https://github.com/Vantage-Connections-Org/agentbar and run install.ps1 (requires the .NET 8 SDK).
- A macOS menu bar version is in progress (not yet available).
